The Musical on Broadway Everything you need to know about the show. The Story Enter a world of splendor and romance, of eye-popping excess, of glitz, grandeur and glory! A world where Bohemians and aristocrats rub elbows and revel in electrifying enchantment. Pop the champagne and prepare for the spectacular spectacular... Welcome to Moulin Rouge! The Musical. Baz Luhrmann's revolutionary film comes to life onstage, remixed in a new musical mash-up extravaganza. A theatrical celebration of truth, beauty, freedom and-above all-LOVE, Moulin Rouge! is more than a musical; it is a state of mind. How wonderful life is...at the Moulin Rouge. How long is Moulin Rouge! The Musical? Moulin Rouge! The Musical is approximately 2 hours and 35 minutes, with one intermission. When is Megan Thee Stallion starring in Moulin Rouge! The Musical? Grammy winner Megan Thee Stallion stars as Zidler in Moulin Rouge! The Musical through May 17, 2026. What is the age recommendation for Moulin Rouge! The Musical? Moulin Rouge! The Musical is recommended for ages 12 and up. Does Moulin Rouge! The Musical contain strobe lights or gun shots? Yes, be advised that Moulin Rouge! The Musical has moments were strobe lights, flashing lights, gunfire and fog are used. What should I wear to Moulin Rouge! The Musical? There is no specific dress code for Moulin Rouge! The Musical , or for any Broadway show. Whether dressed up, casual, or in a Paris-inspired outfit, be sure to dress comfortably and keep in mind the theater may be cool in the summer. Does Moulin Rouge! The Musical have a cast album? Yes! Moulin Rouge! The Musical 's original Broadway cast recording is available on both vinyl and CD at various major retailers. The album is also offered on most streaming and digital music services. Where is Moulin Rouge! The Musical playing on Broadway? Moulin Rouge! The Musical plays at: The Al Hirschfeld Theatre 302 W. 45th St. New York, NY 10036 For information on how to get to the Al Hirschfeld Theatre, head to our guide to The Best Ways to Get to Broadway Theaters . Is Moulin Rouge! The Musical closing? Yes. Moulin Rouge! The Musical will close on August 30, 2026. How many Tony Awards did Moulin Rouge! The Musical win? Moulin Rouge! The Musical was honored with ten Tony Awards in 2021, including Best Musical, Best Leading Actor in a Musical (Aaron Tveit), Best Featured Actor in a Musical (Danny Burstein)m Best Direction of a Musical (Alex Timbers) and Best Choreography (Sonya Tayeh). Cast Christian Douglas Christian Cast & Creative (Christian Douglas, photo by Ted Ely) Christian Douglas Christian Douglas makes his Broadway debut following a year-and-a-half run leading the Moulin Rouge! The Musical National Tour. Prior to his time on the road, he appeared as Charlie Price in the Off-Broadway remount of Kinky Boots at Stage 42. Other favorite credits include Tony in West Side Story at The Muny and the National Tour of Pretty Woman: The Musical . Christian is also a composer and a songwriter. In addition to his own original music, he is the composer/lyricist for a developing new musical, The Sound , which has been a two-time Semi-Finalist for the O'Neill National Musical Theatre Conference. Close Learn More Kelsie Watts Satine Cast & Creative (Kelsie Watts, photo by Jeffrey Mosier) Kelsie Watts Kelsie Watts is a versatile recording artist redefining pop music with her captivating vocals and storytelling. Having collaborated with Backstreet Boys' AJ McLean, she has amassed a dedicated fanbase that includes a star-studded roster of supporters like Diane Warren, Kristin Chenoweth, Tyrese Gibson, Kyle Richards, Jermaine Dupri, and Timbaland. Known for her viral singing videos on social media and empowerment pop anthems, Kelsie's journey continued with SIX as her Broadway debut..
